tests: Where to store session state so web instances become stateless and can scale.
expected: Amazon ElastiCache for Redis — in-memory store with sub-millisecond latency for sessions. Triggers: "session state off the instances", "fast, in-memory".
why_not: RDS — unnecessary relational overhead for sessions; S3 — high latency; Athena — SQL queries over S3, not a session store.
